name: How much does a home renovation consultation cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a home renovation consultation cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many general contractors, including City Dweller, LLC, offer initial home renovation consultations free of charge. This allows both parties to determine if there's a good fit for the project without an upfront financial commitment. During this complimentary meeting, we can discuss your project scope, provide general estimates, and explain our process. Any subsequent detailed design work or extensive planning may involve a separate agreement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial home renovation consultations are often free. This allows you to discuss your project and get general estimates without an upfront cost.
